name: Saga Castle
description: Saga Castle was the Nabeshima domain seat, once the largest castle in Kyushu. The 2004-reconstructed Honmaru palace (with its 400+ tatami audience hall) is the centerpiece; the 19th-century Shachinomon gate is an important cultural property.
notes: The Honmaru museum is free; open daily (closed New Year).
